name: Veyra-NRVideo
description: Bring PS5 GTA6 to 120FPS with DLSS 5. An advanced Windows video player and capture enhancement tool featuring real-time preview for videos, images, and capture card sources. Combine AI-powered Super Resolution, DLSS5 image enhancement, and Frame Generation to deliver a next-generation visual experience.
one_liner: A Windows app that uses AI to make captured game footage or console streams (like a PS5 feed) look sharper and smoother in real time — upscaling resolution and boosting frame rate on the fly.
buyer: A gaming content creator or streamer who records console or capture-card footage and wants it to look like a higher-end PC stream without buying new hardware.
business_use_cases: A YouTube/Twitch streamer runs their console capture through it live to upscale and smooth footage before it hits viewers.
A small video studio uses it to remaster older low-resolution game recordings for re-upload or archival.
A PC-building or gaming-gear reviewer demos it as part of 'free software tricks' content, driving traffic to a paid pro tier.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a paid 'Pro' tier with extra presets, batch processing, or priority support
Sell a curated preset pack tuned for specific games/consoles

steal_this: Already has 100k+ downloads of goodwill behind it — the fast move is a $15 one-time 'preset pack' add-on for specific consoles/games, sold through the project's existing release page, no new product needed.
